rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,083 cash deficit by loosening daytime reinvestment buffers to dynamically synchronize early plot expansion (8-10 plots by Day 6 with 3-4 hands; 15-16 plots by Day 11-12 with 7-9 hands; 10-11 hands cap), enabling 4-5 hyper-fertilized Strawberry flushes across the mid-game. It enforces strict Town Shop duration gating (day + crop_growth_days <= 28; no slow crops after Day 17) and conditions seed purchases on vacant plot availability to protect Strawberry acreage, while lowering early-game liquidation batch thresholds (>=2 surplus on Days 1-5) and clearing shed inventory at Day 29+. Finally, it integrates atomic in-situ harvest-and-water sequencing with pre-seeding hyper-fertilization, purges phantom livestock feed reserves to dynamic n_animals * 3, locks a strict 0.82x liquidation floor (0.88x batch, 0.52 Oracle risk), and caps market orders to 2 per tick to protect worker bandwidth under the 10-order engine cap.
